description: This file contains unit tests for the PlaybackService class, including setup mocks, test scenarios, and utility functions to verify the behavior of the playback service in a media application.

classes.name: PlaybackServiceTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the PlaybackService, including setup of mocks and utility functions for test scenarios.

methods.name: sharedMemoryBufferWillBeInitialized
methods.description: Sets up expectation for creating a shared memory buffer.

methods.name: sharedMemoryBufferWillReturnFdAndSize
methods.description: Sets up expectations for retrieving file descriptor and size from the shared memory buffer mock.

methods.name: createPlaybackServiceShouldSuccess
methods.description: Initializes the PlaybackService instance with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: triggerSwitchToActive
methods.description: Calls the switchToActive method on the PlaybackService instance.

methods.name: triggerSwitchToInactive
methods.description: Calls the switchToInactive method on the PlaybackService instance.

methods.name: triggerSetMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of playbacks in the PlaybackService.

methods.name: triggerSetMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: triggerSetClientDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the client display name in the PlaybackService.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryShouldSucceed
methods.description: Verifies that getSharedMemory returns true and the correct fd and size.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryShouldFail
methods.description: Verifies that getSharedMemory returns false and zeroed fd and size.

methods.name: getShmBufferShouldSucceed
methods.description: Checks that getShmBuffer returns a non-null pointer.

methods.name: getShmBufferShouldFail
methods.description: Checks that getShmBuffer returns a null pointer.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybacksShouldSucceed
methods.description: Verifies that getMaxPlaybacks returns the expected maximum.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayersShouldSucceed
methods.description: Verifies that getMaxWebAudioPlayers returns the expected maximum.

methods.name: clientDisplayNameShouldBeSet
methods.description: Verifies that the client display name environment variable is correctly set and then unset.
